name: AU Hawk
summary: The AU Hawk (owner 2026-10-18): a bubbly caricature of the 1998 series-1 Ford AU Falcon sedan, the burnout and doughnut king. Round 2 rebuilt it to a literal AU reference sheet (named an AU Falcon by a minimal vision model before modelling): two big swept teardrop headlamps wrapping into the guards, the oval fish-mouth grille with one body-colour bar and a plain blank oval badge (no lettering, R81), round fog lamps, a high round roof over a tall glasshouse, round tumblehome flanks and a domed bonnet and boot, rounded corner tail lamps with white reverse lamps and a plain oval on the boot lid, silver five-spoke rims, no wing. Recognition (docs/evidence/P1-V-au-hawk/recognition.md): LOD0's front 3/4 and rear 3/4 views read as an AU Falcon to a minimal vision model most of the time in good windows; LOD1, LOD2, side, top and the chase view don't reliably, and the model's answers drift run to run, so the owner's verdict decides. LOD0 2906 triangles (qualified 3000), LOD1 896, LOD2 600. Code-built from generated reference sheets (R81).
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: The reference sheets were generated with Muse Image from a written brief (art/vehicles/au-hawk/refs/prompts/, the Hawk Dash's sheet as the layout example; art/ui/frames/ledger.jsonl). Per view: the reference crop, the model shaded, and the silhouette diff (green is model only, red is reference only). Scored by tools/vehicles/fit (Spike J's method: perspective camera, the same mask pipeline on both sides, the contact-shadow band left out).

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front detached; door_FL detached; back detached; wheel_FL detached; both front doors and the back detached; a stripped shell. Posed in a three.js viewer about each part's hinge line (tools/vehicles/evidence).

paints.pattern: Seat colour on the paint key (white texels tint: body and bumpers; the glass, lamps, grille, badges, black mirrors, rims and tyres keep their colour), the number on the roof (anchor roof_number) and in the HUD badge. paints-strip.png shows white plus five player colours. No livery: the AU has none.
